d: We are conducting a search on behalf of an established industrial services company in Qatar for an experienced Proposal Manager to lead tendering, estimating and proposal activities across scaffolding, painting, insulation and refractory services.

This is a commercially critical role responsible for managing the complete proposal and tendering process — from initial enquiry and detailed estimating through submission, clarification, negotiation and handover to operations. The focus is on developing competitive, technically sound and profitable proposals while protecting commercial margins.
q: Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Construction Management, Business or a related discipline
10–15+ years’ relevant experience in proposals, estimating, tendering or commercial functions
Strong background within scaffolding, painting, insulation, refractory, Oil & Gas, petrochemical or industrial services
Demonstrated experience preparing competitive and profitable bids
Qatar/GCC market experience is highly preferred
Strong understanding of BOQs, specifications, drawings, unit rates, productivity assumptions and cost build-ups
Experience with both service/application pricing and material supply/rental pricing is highly desirable
Excellent analytical, negotiation and communication skills with strong attention to detail
r: li
Lead the full tender and proposal process , reviewing scopes, BOQs, drawings, specifications and commercial requirements
li
Prepare and manage detailed estimates and pricing for scaffolding, painting, insulation and refractory works
li
Develop cost build-ups covering manpower, materials, equipment, logistics, productivity and subcontractor requirements
li
Establish competitive pricing while protecting target margins and profitability
li
Develop bid strategies based on project requirements, market conditions, competition and commercial risk
li
Coordinate proposal inputs across operations, engineering, procurement, finance and commercial teams
li
Support pre-bid meetings, site visits, tender clarifications and commercial negotiations
li
Maintain market intelligence on labour costs, material pricing, rental rates and competitor positioning
li
Prepare bid-to-budget documentation and ensure effective handover of awarded projects to operations
li
Maintain strong tender controls, pricing accuracy and commercial compliance

d: With over 14,000 professionals globally, GHD is a global professional services company that leads through engineering, architecture and construction expertise. We are employee-owned and committed to addressing humanity’s most urgent needs by making water, energy and urbanisation sustainable for generations to come.

The way we design and build the environment around us changes everything. At GHD, architects, designers, planners, engineers and environmental scientists work together to create places that inspire, connect and endure.

We are looking for an experienced and creative Team Leader - Architecture to provide architectural design leadership on complex, high-profile projects across a range of sectors. You will influence the design direction of major developments, collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and help deliver innovative, client-focused solutions that create lasting community benefit.

As a recognised technical and creative leader, you will guide teams through the design process, balancing design intent, technical excellence, commercial considerations and client expectations. You will also mentor emerging talent and strengthen design capability across the business.
q: A bachelor’s degree in Architecture or an equivalent discipline.
Minimum 10 years’ professional experience in architectural design
Demonstrated experience leading complex projects and managing design delivery.
Strong design, technical and problem-solving capability.
Experience working collaboratively across multidisciplinary project teams.
Excellent stakeholder and client relationship management skills.
Clear and compelling communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and inspire others.
Experience using industry-standard design and BIM tools.
Experience supervising people and resources to deliver agreed outcomes.

At GHD, you can make a meaningful impact. You will be part of a globally connected team delivering complex and rewarding projects, with the opportunity to lead design thinking, grow your career and help shape places that benefit communities for generations to come.
We support our people to bring fresh ideas, challenge the status quo and do their best work. Your success is our success, and together we will create a better built world.

At GHD, we do not just believe in the power of commitment. We live it every day. We empower our people to make a positive impact by combining deep technical expertise with the capabilities of our clients and partners.
r: li
Lead the development and delivery of complex architectural design solutions from concept through to implementation.
li
Establish and champion the design vision for major projects, maintaining quality, innovation and technical rigour.
li
Work closely with clients and project stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver exceptional outcomes.
li
Lead design reviews, feasibility studies and design validation activities.
li
Provide specialist advice on architectural design, construction practices, regulations and industry standards.
li
Support multidisciplinary teams, including BIM, technical and engineering specialists.
li
Contribute to winning work through technical input into proposals, tenders and client presentations.
li
Mentor and develop team members, sharing knowledge and fostering design excellence and continuous improvement.
li
Apply emerging technologies and industry best practice to strengthen project outcomes.
